I know about a lot of resources"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I am a gig worker, so I cannot apply for IU. Its very hard, but i also have some savings."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"What kind of tools would you recommend I use to get through this"},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Well, falling back on savings while you look for more work is good for a while. If you have any food insecurity as a result, there are often local food banks. It's really not something to be embarrased about, so many people face food insecurity through no fault of their own."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"You could also give a call to your local social services because they will be able to tell you what resources would be available, whether it's a vocational program or temporary assistance."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Wow you're so helpful and encouraging! It's very nice to talk to you. "},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Are there any meds you can recommend to help me sleep?"},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Well, if it's possible, I would talk to a doctor. If you're looking for Over-the-counter sleep medication, melatonin has helped me in the past. "}]
